entities.name: Query histidine ammonia-lyase
observations: 512 aa soluble enzyme sequence; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q9EWW1 from Streptomyces coelicolor.
Belongs to the aromatic lyase family, Pfam Lyase_aromatic (PF00221).
Predicted cytoplasmic enzyme; homologs are protein homotetramers.
Catalytic serine is converted to 2,3-didehydroalanine through an internal Cys-Gly cross-link/5-imidazolinone-derived prosthetic group, as annotated for exact homologs.

entities.name: L-histidine ammonia elimination
observations: EC 4.3.1.3 / Rhea RHEA:21232: L-histidine is converted to trans-urocanate and ammonium.
Reaction is an ammonia-lyase elimination, not a hydrolysis or redox reaction.

entities.name: L-histidine degradation
observations: Histidine ammonia-lyase catalyzes the first step of L-histidine degradation toward N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate and ultimately L-glutamate.
